label: Invented sample data
about: Invented variance data for Contoso Asset Management, a fictional company. Every figure, owner and explanation is made up. Used for the sample route and to check the scripts.

explanation.text: Average assets under management were 1.9% above budget after net inflows into fixed income funds.
explanation.evidence: October assets under management report: average assets 1.9% above budget.

explanation.text: Two equity strategies finished the period below their hurdle rates.
explanation.evidence: October fund performance report shows one equity strategy below its hurdle rate; a second is not named.
explanation.gap: The fund performance report shows one equity strategy below its hurdle rate. Which second strategy finished below its hurdle, and what was its fee impact?

explanation.text: Two new platform clients went live in October.
Professional fees were lower because two projects were deferred.
explanation.evidence: The ledger shows professional fees on budget; the underspend sits in premises costs.
explanation.gap: The ledger shows professional fees on budget and the underspend in premises costs. What drove the 3.1 underspend?

explanation.text: Average assets under management were higher after net inflows into fixed income funds.
One equity strategy finished below its hurdle rate.
The annual pay award was paid in September but budgeted for October.

approved_commentary.source: The commentary that was sent (invented sample)

lines.text: Base fees: 6.1 above budget. Average assets under management were higher after net inflows into fixed income funds. Source: September assets under management report.
Performance fees: 3.4 below budget. One equity strategy finished below its hurdle rate. Source: September fund performance report.
Compensation: 4.2 above budget. The annual pay award was paid in September but budgeted for October. Source: September payroll journal summary.

house_style.audience: the Chief Financial Officer and the executive committee
house_style.tone: One entry per material line: the line, the figure against budget, the driver in one sentence, then the source. US$m to one decimal place. Say above or below budget, never favourable or adverse.
house_style.threshold: Comment on lines at or above US$3m against budget.
house_style.template: A headline paragraph, then Revenue and Costs, then one line saying smaller lines are not commented, then the sign-off.
house_style.sign_off: Prepared by FP&A. Reviewed by the Financial Controller.
